name: FIRST-MOMENT-ERASURE-LADDER-1
note: Machine-readable form of PRE-REG FIRST-MOMENT-ERASURE-LADDER-1 (RESULTS L75312; the prose governs). DESIGN ONLY (Artin decision 2026-09-15 08:00 EDT). No instrument, no launch; implementation and the target run each need a separate Artin GO.
question: Does the first-moment perturbation remain magnitude-scaled through the full 7200 -> 15420 continuation of writer A, or does the continuation enter a generic amplification regime in which small initial differences grow and rotate independently of the erased-moment direction?
writer: A only: stock OneCycle seed 2, checkpoints/phase19m/m007200.pt (sha256 a0cdf244fcf44f05...), Adam step 7200, one seed lineage, byte-identical future stream
intervention: exp_avg <- (1 - epsilon) exp_avg at the anchor; exp_avg_sq, Adam step counter, weights, wd, scheduler state, batch order preserved
device: cpu float32, torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), 8 threads, arms sequential, one liverun id fmel1

readouts.dW: W_eps(7200+h) - W_C(7200+h), GLOBAL float64 over the 59 trained tensors, fresh fmel1 arms only
readouts.alpha: least-squares slope of ln||dW_eps(h)|| against ln eps over the four epsilons
readouts.cosmin: min over the 6 epsilon pairs of cos(dW_eps(h), dW_eps'(h))
readouts.function: HELD-32 CE per arm (UGC0 panel 00eb6c43...), dCE_eps = CE_eps - CE_C
readouts.gate: 120 gate at 15420 on C and e1, same mps device, descriptive only

provenance_decision: uniform continuous rerun of all five arms from 7200; historical Stage-0 C and FME1 Z / E snapshots are reference DIGESTS for an in-line qualification only (read from the locked receipts logs/oma1/stage0.json and logs/fme1/treat.json), never data; dependency set = locked receipts + anchor file; payloads under checkpoints/oma1/A/C and checkpoints/fme1 retained until BAR 0 passes, disposition then an Artin decision

bars.0_qualification: at h in {1,5,20,100,900}: fresh C digest == Stage-0 C digest, fresh e1 == FME1 Z digest, fresh e1e-2 == FME1 E digest, bit-exact; any mismatch aborts the run -> NOT-RUN, no control rerun, no relaunch without amendment
bars.1_first_step: |n_1(1) - 0.894284652673395| <= 0.02 and |R_eps(1) - 1| <= 1e-3 for every eps; failure -> NOT-ADJUDICABLE (e1e-3 alone failing -> that arm UNRESOLVED, BAR 2 on the remaining three)
bars.2_regime_at_H: first match wins: FORGOTTEN if n_eps(H) <= 0.05 for all four; MAGNITUDE-SCALED PERSISTENT if alpha(H) >= 0.80 and cosmin(H) >= 0.90 and n_1(H) >= 0.25; NONLINEAR DIRECTION-SHARED if cosmin(H) >= 0.90 and alpha(H) < 0.80; TRAJECTORY-SENSITIVE if alpha(H) <= 0.20 and cosmin(H) <= 0.50; else INTERMEDIATE with alpha(H) and cosmin(H) quoted
bars.3_transition_locus: reported: h_lin = last grid h with alpha(h) >= 0.80 and cosmin(h) >= 0.90; h_dec = first grid h with cosmin(h) <= 0.50; 'not reached' legal
bars.4_function: per arm: NEUTRAL if |dCE_eps(H)| <= max(0.005, 3 |dCE_1e-3(H)|); HARMED above positively; HELPED above negatively; FUNCTION-NEUTRAL when all four NEUTRAL; descriptive list of (eps, h) with |dCE| > 0.005
bars.label: (BAR 2 regime, BAR 4 function) [writer A only, one anchor, one seed lineage, CPU deterministic; gate descriptive], h_lin / h_dec quoted

priors.claim: BAR 0 passes for all three qualified arms
BAR 2: TRAJECTORY-SENSITIVE 0.35 / INTERMEDIATE 0.35 / NONLINEAR DIRECTION-SHARED 0.10 / MAGNITUDE-SCALED PERSISTENT 0.10 / FORGOTTEN 0.10
BAR 5 ratio in [0.9, 1.1] for every eps

cost.basis: FME1: 900 steps in 291 s per arm at 3.1 it/s, 8 threads

storage.snapshots: checkpoints/fmel1/A/<arm>/h<hhhh>.pt, model-only float32 (75.7 MB) at the 12 grid horizons x 5 arms = 4.5 GB; optimizer blob at H only for every arm (0.76 GB); ~5.3 GB untracked, shas + digests in the receipt

stop_law: killed and NOT-RUN at 8 h (2x prior wall)
BAR 0 mismatch aborts the whole run -> NOT-RUN, partial receipts kept
any pin drift refuses at launch, nothing created
live-run law for the whole wall
one run; no retry and no follow-up launch regardless of result

consequences.magnitude_scaled_persistent: AMENDMENT narrowing the FME1 disclosure (late separation content-specific through H on this arena); bank OPTIMIZER-MEMORY-CROSSFOSTER-1 on reproducible states
consequences.nonlinear_direction_shared: book; bank a finer epsilon ladder between the two epsilons where alpha departs from 1
consequences.trajectory_sensitive: book; bank (not arm) a matched-norm random-direction perturbation control on the same arena and the schedule-phase census
consequences.forgotten: book; scope the FME1 PERSISTENT reading to h <= 900 by an in-place FINDINGS note
consequences.non_neutral_arm: named; no functional-importance claim from path divergence in any outcome
consequences.never: writer B; a second anchor; reopening OMA1; a variance-state reset

process: instrument scratch/first_moment_erasure_ladder.py (thin sibling of scratch/first_moment_erasure.py; pins extended by the FME1 receipt sha; mode ladder; grid + ladder literals; tests; path-isolated smoke; instrument review; clean-tree audit; commit)
Artin GO for the target run: bash scratch/fmel1_launch.sh under liverun fmel1 at the committed HEAD
